references.phrase: colimit of a diagram of sets
become equal at some later common stage
references.context: Set theory and category theory: equivalence of representatives under forward transition maps in a filtered diagram

references.disposition: The eventual equality description refers to set-valued diagrams and is not an elementwise definition valid in every category C.

review_rationale: Inspected the filtered-colimit meaning in arbitrary category C together with its specialized Sets description, distinguishing the colimit universal property from the eventual identification relation on elements.
